faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Theni Social Worker – II SJPU recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DCPU Theni Social Worker – II SJPU recruitment is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Social Worker – II SJPU post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates, preferably with a B.A. in Social Work, Sociology, or Social Sciences from a recognized university. Proficiency in computers and work experience are also considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Social Worker – II SJPU post is 42 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Social Worker – II SJPU position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18536 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC, SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DCPU Theni Social Worker – II SJPU posts?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website and sending it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Social Worker – II SJPU post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contract-based.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the District Child Protection Unit Theni located?
faq.answer: The District Child Protection Unit Theni is located in Theni, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 625531.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with work experience get preference?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with relevant work experience will be given weightage during the selection process.
